column1: # Internal helpers: reachable, called only by other database code, yet
# exposed over HTTP because Supabase grants EXECUTE on public to anon.
# keep-policy  referenced by an RLS policy. Policy predicates run as the
#              querying role, so revoking locks every user out of the table.
# keep-invoker called by a SECURITY INVOKER function, which runs it as the
# revocable    every caller is SECURITY DEFINER, so the helper runs as the
#              definer regardless of who called in.
# Advisory. Not applied: see db_schema/REFACTOR.md on sequencing.
